observations: The page number «( 8 )» stands at the head of the page, centred. The page has no footnotes and no signature.

L17: the vertical bar between «cum» and «uacua» marks the beginning of fol. 104 verso of the manuscript, which the note in the left margin, «car. 104 verso.», names (on this left-hand page the folio notes stand in the left margin); transcribed as a margin note.

L12: «sub leuabis» is printed as two words, with a word space of 20 px, where L21 prints «subleuabis» as one; transcribed as printed. L14: «infra x;»: the numeral is printed without its points, where L15 and L23 print «infra .x.,».

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): L05 «alterum : addes», with spaces before and after the colon (19 and 30 px); without a space after the mark, L08 «decenos.Cum» (9 px, the median word space of the line 17 px) and «differentiarum,idest» (11 px), L09 «decenorum,siue» (9 px) and L10 «unum,et» (5 px); L22 «centum ;» (17 px before the semicolon), with a space. L12 «decem, facies» and L25 «fuerit. Si» have a space: the cross-bar of the f and a pencil stroke shorten the measured gaps.
copy_matter: A reader's notes in pencil: «addere» in the left margin beside L05, with «addes» underlined; L06, a stroke over «ff» of «differentiam»; L12, a curve linking «sub» and «leuabis»; «tt» in the left margin beside L15, with «ct» of «dimictens» underlined, and «Quod» in the right margin, with «et» marked; «· eam» in the left margin beside L17, with «ea,» underlined; L18, a stroke at the «p» of «prima»; L20, a hook at the «s» of «rentiis»; L25, a slash before «Si», and «L §» in the left margin; «fuit / illa» in the left margin beside L30-L31, with strokes above «fuerit» (L30) and under «illo» (L31). Not part of the edition.
